import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Solution {

    public static Integer[][][] memo;

    public static int countValid(int pos, int placeholderVal, int lastTwo, int n, String pattern) {
        if (pos == n) {
            return (lastTwo == 0 || lastTwo == 25 || lastTwo == 50 || lastTwo == 75) ? 1 : 0;
        }
        if (memo[pos][placeholderVal][lastTwo] != null) {
            return memo[pos][placeholderVal][lastTwo];
        }
        int result = 0;
        char c = pattern.charAt(pos);
        if (c == 'X') {
            if (placeholderVal != 10) {
                result = countValid(pos + 1, placeholderVal, (lastTwo % 10) * 10 + placeholderVal, n, pattern);
            } else {
                for (int digit = (pos == 0 ? 1 : 0); digit < 10; digit++) {
                    result += countValid(pos + 1, digit, (lastTwo % 10) * 10 + digit, n, pattern);
                }
            }
        } else if (c == '_') {
            for (int digit = (pos == 0 ? 1 : 0); digit < 10; digit++) {
                result += countValid(pos + 1, placeholderVal, (lastTwo % 10) * 10 + digit, n, pattern);
            }
        } else {
            int digit = c - '0';
            result += countValid(pos + 1, placeholderVal, (lastTwo % 10) * 10 + digit, n, pattern);
        }
        return memo[pos][placeholderVal][lastTwo] = result;
    }

    public static void process(InputReader in, PrintWriter out) {
        String s = in.next();
        int len = s.length();
        if (len == 1) {
            out.println(s.equals("0") ? 1 : 0);
        } else if (s.charAt(0) == '0') {
            out.println(0);
        } else {
            memo = new Integer[len][11][100];
            out.println(countValid(0, 10, 0, len, s));
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        new Thread(() -> {
            try (PrintWriter pw = new PrintWriter(System.out)) {
                process(new InputReader(System.in), pw);
            }
        }).start();
    }

    static class InputReader {
        private final BufferedReader br;
        private StringTokenizer st;

        public InputReader(InputStream is) {
            br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(is), 32768);
        }

        public String next() {
            while (st == null || !st.hasMoreTokens()) {
                try {
                    st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
                } catch (IOException e) {
                    throw new RuntimeException(e);
                }
            }
            return st.nextToken();
        }

        public int nextInt() {
            return Integer.parseInt(next());
        }

        public long nextLong() {
            return Long.parseLong(next());
        }
    }
}
